Octeka.Mirror - Package Installer, Launcher, and Auto-Updater

Usage:
  mirror run <package>[@<version>] [-- <arguments>]
  mirror install <package>[@<version>] [--bin-dir <path>] [--mode SeparateProcess|Embedded] [--elevation]
  mirror uninstall <package>[@<version>] [--bin-dir <path>] [--service <name>] [--keep-data] [--elevation]
  mirror update [<package>[@<version>]] [--service <serviceName>]
  mirror check <package>[@<version>] [--current-version <version>]
  mirror search [<query>] [--tag <tag>] [--package-type <type>] [--all] [--prerelease]
  mirror list [--available]

Examples:
  mirror run MyApp@1.0.0 -- --port 8080
  mirror install MyApp@latest --bin-dir C:\Tools\bin
  mirror uninstall MyApp --bin-dir C:\Tools\bin
  mirror update mirror@latest
  mirror update MyService --service MyServiceName
  mirror search --tag octeka-tool
  mirror list
